hard_coded: The 6 archetypal patterns: COUNT, SUM, PERCENTAGE, TAT_DAYS, RATIO, BOOL_FRACTION

rules.description: Mean processing time per RM for decided loans, from application_date to last_updated
Amount recovered / outstanding NPL per recovery officer (active cases)
% of pipeline opportunities won out of closed (Closed Won + Closed Lost) per staff

% of high-risk AML alerts where STR was filed per officer (proper escalation discipline). v10.111 wires to real aml_alerts table after the name→code resolver landed; was previously a loan_applications.compliance_flag proxy with invert:true.
Total approved/disbursed loan value per RM in the period (staff-level companion to bank-aggregate K001 from cbs_loans)
% of decided loans where tat_days <= sla_target_days per RM (loan-processing slice of generic SLA Adherence)
Number of active pipeline deals per staff (excluding Closed Won/Lost)
% of referrals converted per referrer in the period
Total active-stage pipeline value held per staff (KES); excludes Closed Won/Lost/Disbursed
Number of active recovery cases per officer
Total amount recovered per officer (KES, active cases)
Number of loans approved per RM in the period
Number of referrals made per referrer in the period
Number of converted referrals per referrer (period filter on conversion_date)
Number of legal matters completed per legal officer
% of completed legal matters where SLA was breached per legal officer (library direction:lower already matches the rule's emission, so invert:false)
Actual revenue / target revenue per campaign owner
% of mandatory trainings completed per staff (True=completed)
Number of completed training courses per staff in the period
% of submitted/approved reviews that were on-time per reviewee
Number of approved performance reviews per reviewee in the period
Total approved leave days per staff in the period
Number of approved leave requests per staff in the period
Total hours of completed training per staff in the period
% of performance reviews per reviewee that have been submitted
% of resolved incidents per assignee where sla_breached=False (use invert:true to flip the rate-of-bad emission to rate-of-clean)
Number of incidents closed per assignee in the period
Number of agent fraud alerts reviewed (status not Open) per assigned role-holder
% of board papers submitted on time per submitter (submitted_on_time bool)
% of submitted CBK returns filed on time per reviewer (uses on_time bool with submitted=True predicate)
% of completed DPO register items finished on time per dpo_reviewer (DPIA + breaches + ROPA covered uniformly)
% of completed projects delivered on or before planned end date per project manager (strict on-time via date_le_field DSL type added in v10.115)
% of audit reviews where status=Closed per auditor
Audit findings closed / findings total per auditor (closed-status reviews only)
% of closed audit reviews NOT breaching SLA per auditor (uses invert:true since sla_breached=True is bad)
Mean merchant onboarding TAT (days) per RM, computed from the pre-computed tat_days field on Active/Suspended/Terminated merchants
Mean account opening TAT (hours) per RM, on completed onboardings (current_stage=Active Customer)
% of sanctions hits cleared (Cleared - False Positive or Clear status) per reviewer in the period

% of EWS cases resolved (status=Resolved or stage=Green) per RM. Note: current CBS-mock has all 18 cases Active so this rule produces 0% — preserved for forward compatibility when resolutions are seeded.
Number of operational risk loss events reported per reporter in the period

Number of near-miss op-risk events captured per reporter (gross_loss_kes < threshold proxy when type field doesn't include explicit Near Miss). Currently uses gross_loss_kes < 50000 as the near-miss threshold.
Number of cards activated per RM in the period (status in [Active, Activated])
Total YTD card spend (KES) per RM on active cards (status=Active or Activated)
% of disputes resolved within SLA per RM (numerator: dispute_resolved AND dispute_actual_days <= dispute_sla_days; denominator: has_dispute=True)
Total active retailer finance portfolio per RM (status in [Disbursed, Repaying, Approved])
% of retailer finance facilities classified as NPL per RM
Total trade finance LC value (KES) per RM on active LCs (status in active/closed-positive states)
Total bid bond commission revenue (KES) per RM on active/issued bonds
Number of bid bonds issued per RM (excludes Application/draft status)
% of issued bonds that were called per RM (Called status / non-Application status)
% of strategic initiatives currently On Track per owner (status=On Track / all)
Mean completion_pct across an owner's initiatives — reuses TAT_FIELD pattern as a generic mean-of-numeric-field aggregator. Higher = better execution.
Sum of actions_closed / sum of action_items per submitter (only papers with action_items > 0). Multiplied by 100 conceptually for the BSC; the rule emits the ratio (0-1.0+).
Total net operational risk losses (KES) per reporter on closed/under-review events
% of AML cases that have been closed per assigned reviewer (Closed-No Action or Cleared) vs all assigned
% of completed (non-abandoned) onboardings that achieved first login within 7 days per RM
% of onboardings that were not abandoned per RM (numerator: abandoned=False; denominator: all)
Mean accuracy_score (0-100) of submitted CBK returns per reviewer. Uses MEAN_FIELD pattern (v10.118 alias for TAT_FIELD; same engine, broader naming since the field is not a TAT measure).
Number of active POS merchants per RM (active=True)
Mean completeness_score (50-100) per analyst on loan applications. Uses nested extractor on analyst.code since analyst is stored as a {code, name} dict in loan_applications.
% of loan applications closed within SLA per RM (tat_days <= sla_target_days; denominator is decided/closed loans only)
% of closed deals that were won per staff (numerator: stage in [Disbursed, Closed Won, Signed]; denominator: closed-stage deals).
% of active projects within budget per project manager (numerator: pct_budget_used <= 100; denominator: not in [Cancelled, Initiation]). Uses name_lookup on project_manager.
Number of projects completed (pct_complete >= 100) per project manager. Uses name_lookup on project_manager.
Ratio of regulatory findings closed to total findings per reviewer (only returns with regulatory_findings > 0)
% of alerts escalated to STR for which the STR was filed per assigned reviewer
Total YTD merchant acquiring revenue (KES) per RM on active merchants
Total fraud-related loss (KES) per RM on cards flagged for fraud (fraud_flagged=True). Period filter on dispute_filed_date (when fraud was reported). Lower is better; BSC engine handles direction.
% of purchase requests that have been decided (Approved or Rejected) per requester. Proxy for PR processing throughput; an SLA-day field would refine this in v10.121+.
Mean audit score (1-5) per auditor across closed reviews. KPI library entry uses 'Audit Score' as ID (not K-coded). Forward-compat with library naming.

Mean disbursement TAT (days) per RM on retailer finance facilities. Filters out rows where disbursement_date is missing or precedes application_date (data-quality issue surfaced via the date_le_field predicate).
Number of recovery cases worked per officer (any case with demand_letters_sent > 0 OR amount_recovered > 0). Demonstrates non-K-coded library entry support, like 'Audit Score' in v10.120.

% of EWS cases resolved per RM. Mirrors K047 logic since the library has both K033 and K047 as separate entries on the same source — banks may track resolution rate at multiple aggregation levels. Forward-compat: ews_cases seed has all status=Active, so emits 0% per resolving RM until data populates.

% of data breaches reported within 72 hours per DPO reviewer. Forward-compat: dpo_register seed has type=Breach rows with on_time=None universally; rule emits no actuals until data populates. Designed for production deployment where regulatory filings populate on_time consistently.

% of ROPA records currently up-to-date per DPO reviewer (status=Active or Approved out of all type=ROPA records). Forward-compat: dpo_register seed has type=ROPA rows with dpo_reviewer=None universally; rule emits no actuals until data populates.
% of resolved/closed tickets that hit SLA per assignee. Numerator: status in [Resolved, Closed] AND within_sla=True. Denominator: status in [Resolved, Closed] (decided tickets only).

Mean ticket resolution time (days) per assignee on resolved tickets. MEAN_FIELD on actual_days for status in [Resolved, Closed]. Open tickets are excluded (no actual_days yet); a separate v10.123+ rule may track open-ticket aging.
Number of branch daily logs completed per submitter (status=Submitted). Counts only on-time submissions; late/missed are counted by K053's denominator.
% of daily logs submitted on time per submitter. Numerator: on_time=True. Denominator: all logs (including Late/Missed).
% of staff retained over the past 12 months per manager. Numerator: retained_12m=True. Denominator: all hr records under that manager. Manager owns their team's retention.
% of staff occupying budgeted roles per manager. Higher is better — closer to 100% means headcount aligns with org design (no off-budget hires).

Mean ENPS score (0-10 scale) per manager across their team. Production deployment may compute the canonical Promoter-minus-Detractor score from the underlying enps_score field; the mean here is a simpler proxy.
Year-to-date training hours per staff. Note: aggregates per staff_code (not manager_code) — staff own their own training hours. Overrides the hr-table default staff_field of manager_code.
Mean agent uptime % per supervisor. Aggregates uptime_pct across all agents under each supervisor.

Mean BSC total_score per staff. Period filter on last_updated (2026-04) selects scores updated this period; production deployment may use period_end with a 'previous quarter' resolver. Forward-compatible — rule emits actuals for any quarter that has scores with last_updated in the current month.
% of clearing instructions that failed per processor (status in [Failed, Returned, Reversed]). Lower is better.
% of settled clearing instructions that settled same-day per processor. Numerator: settled_same_day=True AND status=Settled. Denominator: status=Settled. Higher is better.
% of clearing instructions reconciled per processor (reconciled=True / all). Higher is better.
Mean NPS score (0-10) per RM across customer survey responses. Higher is better. Production deployment may compute the canonical NPS = %Promoters - %Detractors; this is a simpler proxy.
% of survey responses classified as Promoter (score >=9) per RM. Third non-K-coded library entry wired (after 'Audit Score' v10.120 and 'Collection Throughput' v10.121).
% of CBK returns filed on time per filer. Numerator: on_time=True. Denominator: all returns assigned (including Pending/Late). Higher is better.
% of customer complaints resolved per agent (status=Resolved / all). Higher is better. Production deployment may add SLA-band cuts.
Mean productivity_score (1-100) per manager across their team. Fourth non-K-coded library entry wired (after Audit Score, Collection Throughput, CX Score).
Number of sanctions screening records reviewed per reviewer in the period. Proxy for refresh frequency — each new watch_list_version triggers re-screening.
Number of activated partnerships (activated=True) per RM in the period.
% of managed vendors that are fully compliant (kyc_complete + contract_in_place + insurance_valid) per owner.
% of agent fraud alerts cleared per investigator (cleared=True / all alerts assigned).
% of pledged collateral reviewed in the period per credit officer (reviewed_in_period=True / all).
Mirrors K028 — KPI library has both K028 and K048 with the same name 'Collateral Review Completion (%)'. Both wire identical logic; library may consolidate in a future cleanup.
Mean 360 feedback score (1-5 scale) per ratee across all rater perspectives (manager, peer, direct report, cross-functional).
